exposure: Idiopathic Ovarian Vein Thrombosis (OVT) unrelated to pregnancy or other noted risk factors
outcome: Resolution of symptoms after warfarin treatment
cohort: A previously healthy, 32-year-old female presenting with chronic right-sided abdominal pain.
finding: This case highlights the importance of considering Ovarian Vein Thrombosis (OVT) as a rare cause of unexplained chronic abdominal pain in young females, even in the absence of typical risk factors like pregnancy or thrombophilia.
followup_time: 6 months (duration of warfarin treatment until symptom resolution)
